Here are key facts about the Roman Empire as (subject, predicate, object) triples:

**Founding & Timeline**
- (Roman Empire, was established, 27 BCE)
- (Augustus, became, first Roman Emperor)
- (Roman Republic, transformed into, Roman Empire)
- (Western Roman Empire, fell in, 476 CE)
- (Eastern Roman Empire, continued as, Byzantine Empire)

**Territory & Expansion**
- (Roman Empire, controlled, Mediterranean Basin)
- (Roman Empire, extended from, Britain to Mesopotamia)
- (Roman Empire, included, North Africa)
- (Roman Empire, conquered, Gaul)
- (Roman Empire, annexed, Egypt)

**Notable Emperors**
- (Augustus, ruled, 27 BCE - 14 CE)
- (Trajan, expanded empire to, greatest extent)
- (Constantine, founded, Constantinople)
- (Constantine, legalized, Christianity)
- (Diocletian, divided empire into, Eastern and Western halves)

**Government & Society**
- (Roman Empire, had, centralized government)
- (Emperor, held, absolute power)
- (Roman Empire, used, professional legions)
- (Roman Empire, practiced, slavery)
- (Roman citizens, had, legal rights)

**Culture & Achievements**
- (Romans, built, extensive road network)
- (Romans, constructed, aqueducts)
- (Romans, developed, Roman law)
- (Romans, spoke, Latin)
- (Roman Empire, practiced, religious tolerance initially)

**Military & Infrastructure**
- (Roman legions, conquered, vast territories)
- (Romans, built, Colosseum)
- (Romans, constructed, Pantheon)
- (Roman roads, connected, entire empire)
- (Roman army, used, advanced tactics)
